title: Entity Sound Event
description: Maps gameplay events to sound effects for the entity, enabling custom audio for actions like attacking, being hurt, dying, or ambient idle sounds. Reference sounds defined in sound_definitions.json to give custom mobs distinctive audio identities that match their visual design and behavior.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Overall adjustment to the volume level of the set of sounds

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.description: Overall adjustment to the pitch level of the set of sounds
